subject.title: fix: prevent LINE channel reloads from hanging on stalled deliveries

question: Do the LINE delivery and security owners accept the intended five-second shutdown tradeoff: replacement recovery may overlap an original accepted handler that later completes?
rationale: The branch changes ownership timing for accepted inbound deliveries. Tests demonstrate the proposed state transitions, but only maintainers can decide whether the remaining at-least-once overlap is acceptable for the channel’s delivery contract.

options.title: Accept bounded recovery
options.body: Accept the five-second grace after reviewing redacted runtime proof that documents the overlap and confirms recovery behavior.

options.title: Keep unbounded ownership
options.body: Reject bounded disposal and retain the existing wait until core can safely cancel or fence the original handler.

options.title: Redesign the ownership contract
options.body: Pause this branch and define an explicit cancellation or lease-fencing mechanism before allowing replacement recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the five-second grace after reviewing redacted runtime proof that documents the overlap and confirms recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch and the related merged messaging work both identify this contributor as the strongest available routing candidate for the affected LINE ingress path.
